easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Airbender Ascension's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Airbender Ascension's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Airbender Ascension
uses.cardState: with four or more quest counters on it
